integrity: The sharp bound has a geometric proof. The finite classification is supported by two separate exact finite-field implementations. This is computational evidence, not independent external attestation.
scientific_limitations: The count 180 is for defining cubics modulo nonzero scalar in one fixed projective plane over F4, not an isomorphism-class count. The result concerns geometrically integral cubics distinct from the fixed Hermitian cubic; no parameter-uniform formula is asserted.
title: Sharp seven-point intersections with the Hermitian cubic over \(\mathbb F_4\)
